text:
In this GTA 6 Buck's Jewelry and Pawn Robbery Guide, I'll show you how to rob Buck's the right way in Port Gellhorn, as part of the main story mission Hit Buck's Pawn Shop, so you take all the loot and nobody calls the cops.

The game wants you to do this with Lucia, or with Jason if you're playing as Lucia, but their AI is pretty bad here, so you have to move fast. Hold L1/left bumper and press R1/right bumper, then go up and put on a face mask. If you don't have one, some gun shops sell them. You'll also want a gun with a silencer, and I highly recommend a silenced assault rifle for these missions. If you want to be really meticulous, go at night.

Here are my perfect heist tips and tricks. Run in, use focus right away so you can get behind the first guy and have time to think, then swap to the assault rifle. Shoot the other guys in non-lethal spots, threaten the last one, and loot him. Then run straight to the back and disable the alarm. If you disable it fast enough, nobody comes, which is how you get through with no cops called. Destroy the camera footage while you're back there.

For all the loot, break open the first spot and take the money, then break open the safe nearby, which has more money and jewelry. Make sure you have room for the cash. I came in full, so I could only grab the jewelry. Then smash every case and take all the jewelry. If you hit someone in the head by accident and want the non-lethal run, you may have to load your save.

When you're done, take everything to Dunk's trailer, or wherever your fence is, and sell the stash there.
